description: This Java class defines configuration properties for Hono's credentials API when using a file-based registry. It extends a base configuration class, specifies a default credentials file location, and includes a property for configuring bcrypt hashing iterations.

classes.name: FileBasedCredentialsConfigProperties
classes.description: Configuration properties holder for credentials API using a file-based registry, including bcrypt iteration settings and default file location.

methods.name: getDefaultFileName
methods.description: Returns the default filename for storing credentials, overriding parent method.

methods.name: getMaxBcryptIterations
methods.description: Gets the maximum number of bcrypt hashing iterations for passwords.

methods.name: setMaxBcryptIterations
methods.description: Sets the maximum number of bcrypt hashing iterations; validates that the value is between 4 and 31.
